backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: Orqen copies its own data into a folder on this machine. Backups hold no passwords or tokens; those stay in the system credential store and have to be entered again after a restore.

settings.pattern: If a secret-like value is found in the data

patterns.fail: Stop the backup and tell me
patterns.exclude_artifact: Leave that file out and continue

prune.title: Remove old backups
prune.help: Removes the backups outside your retention settings. This cannot be undone.

preview.title: Restore preview
preview.heldRuns_one: {{count}} run would be held until you resume it.
preview.heldRuns_other: {{count}} runs would be held until you resume them.
preview.republish_one: {{count}} model profile must be published again.
preview.republish_other: {{count}} model profiles must be published again.
preview.cliHelp: Restoring replaces an install, so it runs from the command line with Orqen stopped. Try it first with --dry-run.
preview.cannot: A restore of this backup is not possible as things stand.

bundle.title: Support bundle
bundle.help: A JSON file with versions, preflight and health results, extension states and recent job failures. It contains no secrets and no home folder names.

restore.title: Restore
restore.how: Stop Orqen, then run the restore command against an empty install. Runs that were in progress come back held.
restore.none: This install has not been restored from a backup.
restore.heldRuns_one: {{count}} run is held until you resume it.
restore.heldRuns_other: {{count}} runs are held until you resume them.
